transcript: Festival Day 2 let's go the first concert of the day which is the 80s concert is currently happening did grab some breakfast outside of the festival so we're now coming now it's nice to know that even though the concert has already started we have seats waiting for us there's a lot of overlap of stuff I wanna see today so we're doing our first half show which is what I did for likes and then I'll be back at the main stage for the new musical preview best way to stay cool a jug of lemonade that last concert ran really long they just ended at 4 the Jason Robert Brown concert is supposed to start at 4 they have to swap the stage over so I figure I'm gonna go check out trivia Unfortunately the Wi Fi just completely stopped working, it kicked me out to many times But this is fun it's about 15 minutes before rent and I don't need to see the beginning of it so I'm gonna just take this time to get food fill up my water bottle we got our daily ice cream the rent concert is starting right now gonna finish up the night singing around the campfire Stayed so long we're literally running for the last shuttle but what a great what a great second day at the festival
